title: Candesartan Cilexetil in Heart Failure Assessment of Reduction in Mortality and Morbidity (CHARM Preserved)
brief_summary: A study to evaluate the effect of Atacand on patients with heart failure with preserved left ventricular function
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or female aged 18 or above
* Congestive Heart Failure with symptoms for more than 4 weeks before starting study
* Provision of informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Current low blood pressure with symptoms
* Liver disease considered significant by the study doctor
* Pregnant or lactating females
